parameter_refs.name: applicable_designated_duration_s
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: actual reviewed stop-specific duration; 15 s synthetic diagnostic only

quote: The operator of a bus, other than a tour bus, shall: Not stand or park a bus at a bus stop or an origin or destination point for a period of time longer than has been designated for such bus stop or origin or destination point in accordance with Section 11.60.010 [DEF-LVMC-11-60-010].

activation.condition: Operator of a covered non-tour bus stands or parks at a source-reviewed bus stop; cell is residential bus stop.

obligation.description: Do not stand or park longer than the actual applicable stop-specific designated duration under Section 11.60.010.

timing.description: Measure complete continuous standing or parking interval including activity changes and end; do not infer duration from a sign alone.
